name: Cultivating Happiness
source:
As you watch TV, an odd commercial comes on, and it really speaks to you. Like, directly.

[From [url=https://professoroneira.itch.io/cultivating-happiness]Itch.io[/url]]

你正在看電視，突然播出一則奇怪的廣告，而且它說的內容正說中你的心意。簡直就像在直接對你說話。
